metadata.description: Portfolio of Cristofe Albuquerque — Full Stack Developer specialized in Next.js, NestJS, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL.

hero.title: Full Stack Developer focused on building modern and scalable applications
hero.intro: Hi, I'm <strongName>Cristofe Albuquerque</strongName>. I build end-to-end solutions — bridging fluid interfaces in <strongTech>Next.js</strongTech> with robust <strongTech>NestJS</strongTech> backends, relational databases, and production deployments.

about.title: Software engineering focused on architecture, security, and real-world production.
about.p1: My core foundation is in frontend engineering, crafting fast, responsive, and polished interfaces with Next.js, React, and TypeScript.
about.p2: Expanding this background into the full stack ecosystem, I build structured NestJS APIs, model PostgreSQL databases, and manage Docker deployments on Linux and Cloud servers.
about.p3: I focus on clean code, well-defined data contracts with Zod, and decoupled architectures that keep codebases easy to maintain.

p1.title: BFF Architecture & Modern Frontend
p1.desc: Next.js App Router integrated with enterprise APIs, hybrid rendering, and secure route handlers.

p2.title: Authentication & Security
p2.desc: Granular RBAC access control, secure HttpOnly cookies, and end-to-end data protection.

p3.title: Strict Typing & Validation
p3.desc: Strict TypeScript across frontend and backend, with real-time schema validation via Zod.

p4.title: Containers & Infrastructure
p4.desc: Isolated environments with Docker Compose, Caddy reverse proxy, and optimized video streaming.

stack.title: Technologies I use daily
stack.desc: Tools and technologies in which I have practical hands-on experience to create resilient, fast, and secure applications from UI to deployment.

projects.title: Featured Applications & Projects
projects.desc: End-to-end applications — from relational data modeling and enterprise APIs to modern, responsive interfaces.

lmsFront.title: LMS — Next.js Frontend
lmsFront.description: Educational platform built with Next.js App Router and BFF architecture. Focused on end-to-end security, efficient on-demand media playback, and a fluid, responsive user experience.
lmsFront.h1: HTML5 video player with HTTP Range Requests support (206 Partial Content)
lmsFront.h2: HttpOnly cookie authentication with SameSite and edge middleware
lmsFront.h3: BFF architecture with strict real-time schema validation via Zod + React Hook Form
lmsFront.h4: Atomic state management with Zustand and modular styling with SCSS Modules

lmsNest.title: LMS — NestJS Backend
lmsNest.description: Scalable enterprise API built with NestJS and PostgreSQL, focused on high-performance secure streaming, domain-driven architecture, and advanced security.
lmsNest.h1: On-demand streaming (HTTP 206) protected and offloaded by Caddy via X-Accel-Redirect
lmsNest.h2: Granular RBAC access control, secure __Secure-sid cookie sessions, and Argon2id + Salt + Pepper hashing
lmsNest.h3: Automated testing with Vitest and relational data modeling in PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM
lmsNest.h4: Container orchestration with Docker Compose, health checks, isolated networks, and optimized multi-stage builds

lmsExpress.title: LMS — Express API
lmsExpress.description: First version of the platform API built with Express and TypeScript. Served as the validation foundation for the subsequent structured migration to the NestJS ecosystem.
lmsExpress.h1: RESTful API with typed TypeScript routes and JWT authentication
lmsExpress.h2: Relational PostgreSQL data modeling and direct SQL queries without ORM
lmsExpress.h3: Core study foundation that guided architectural decisions in NestJS

portfolio.title: Personal Portfolio
portfolio.description: Modern web application built with Next.js 16 to showcase projects and engineering experience, featuring native multilingual support and automated tests.
portfolio.h1: Static Site Generation (SSG) and native i18n (PT/EN) with next-intl
portfolio.h2: Automated component and utility testing with Vitest and Testing Library
portfolio.h3: Continuous integration (CI) pipeline with GitHub Actions and Schema.org SEO
